literal: Deceit grasping, excellence without, they will not do; blemish free lineage upholding we will live, those who say.
translation: Those who say, "We will live upholding our flawless lineage," will not resort to deceit to do deeds devoid of excellence.
modern: குற்றமற்ற தமது குடியின் பெருமையைக் காத்து வாழ்வோம் என்று சொல்பவர்கள், வஞ்சகத்தைக் கையாண்டு பெருமை இல்லாத செயல்களைச் செய்ய மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet defines the integrity of those who value their family's honor. The phrase 'mācu aṟṟa kulam paṟṟi vāḻtum eṉpār' refers to people who are determined to live in a way that upholds their flawless lineage. To maintain this honor, they will never engage in 'calam', which means deceit or baseness in this context. Consequently, they will completely avoid actions that lack 'cālpu' or moral excellence.
